welcome_page.image_alt: #Street lamp at night with a safety shield
welcome_page.description:
This SmartUrbanity questionnaire focuses on perceived safety, security and environmental conditions during your journeys. Your answers help us understand which street and urban factors influence comfort, risk and accessibility. Participation is voluntary. Your answers are not linked to your name. They are stored under a pseudonymous code derived from your email address, so that your answers to different SmartUrbanity questionnaires can be analysed together. Your email address itself is never saved, and this questionnaire does not record your location.

Learn more about SmartUrbanity

sections.title: Safety Perception
sections.description: Questions about how safe and secure you feel during your typical journey (the trip you most commonly make in your daily life, such as travelling to work, university, school, shopping, or other regular activities). These questions refer both to safety (protection from accidents or physical harm) and security (protection from crime, harassment, or feeling unsafe).
